total_exactness.fix: GET /api/postmortems calls store.list_postmortem_page(). JSON store (IncidentStore): full in-memory set, exact filter/count/page. PostgresIncidentStore: streams a narrow column projection through PostgresJsonOwnerStore.list_all_selected (small per-row tuples, never the wide JSONB payload; incident_evidence_summary selected only for rows the infra predicate can match), filters/counts total and hidden_infrastructure_count and pages in Python over those tuples, then fetches only the requested page's payloads by record_id. Free-text q selects candidates in SQL (ILIKE over payload text) and confirms with the matcher. HISTORY_READ_ROW_CAP is not applied and no capped number is reported as total; the previous list_all_postmortems (all full payloads per request) is removed.
